label: Delay at fixed gain
subgoals: Fix the electrical effort h for every gate
Compute each gate's delay as g h plus p
Sum the stage delays along the path

label: Sizing realizes the gain
subgoals: Measure each gate's output load after mapping
Set its input capacitance to the load divided by h
Propagate the new input capacitances backward to the drivers

label: Comparing structures, not loads
subgoals: Compute each candidate structure's delay from g and p
Pick the structure with the smaller delay
Identify fanout and wire load as where fixed gain breaks
